player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ta'a Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma keessa {num_rounds} raundi irraa gahu.

Gocha Qulqulluu:
- Qarree hundaa dura, siif {total_conversation_rounds} gilgaalee marii bilisummaa godhu.
- San booda, gareen lamaanuu waltajjii isaanii irratti walii galuu ykn haangawu.

Payoff Matrix (raundi hundaa walii gala):
- Lachuun Cooperate ➜ tokkoon tokkoon {cooperate_reward}
- Lachuun Defect ➜ tokkoon tokkoon {mutual_defect_reward}
- Tokko Defects, tokko Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Akkaa Taphachuu:
- Marii keessa: qubeewwan marii bilisummaa barreessu.
- Qarree murteeffannaa keessa: '[Cooperate]' ykn '[Defect]' (case-insensitive) dabaluu. Qubeewwan dabaluun danda'uu dura/fudhatu token.

phases.conversation_finished: Haasaasa jiddutti {round} keessa bahee. Dhaga'a '[Cooperate]' ykn '[Defect]' በአባረረው መስጫ መስተንጽሮ ቁጽሮ{{}} ውስጥ.

outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Taphachi 0 waliin hojjete, taphattuun 1 garuu ni baqate.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Taphachi 0 kan ofirraa bu'e, taphattuun 1 ammoo waliin hojjete.
